content.text:
I submitted **index 109** (Ca 0.19, Co 0.18, Mn 0.63). At 5×10⁻⁸ A it had the highest photocurrent of the three films I measured, but I have no evidence it is close to the best in the 183-film library.

| Index | Region | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|
| 109 | Mn-rich | 5×10⁻⁸ |
| 12 | Co-rich (Co 0.70) | 1×10⁻⁸ |
| 49 | Ca-rich (Ca 0.47) | −1.2×10⁻⁷ (negative, so a reduction current rather than water oxidation) |

I made a mistake with the budget. I sent all three merit measurements at once, one per corner of the composition range, so I learned nothing from one before choosing the next. A better approach would have been to measure one or two spread-out films first, then spend the rest near whichever did best. Taken together, the results only roughly suggest that Mn-rich films are the better region.

I also didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. They could have shown the crystal phases present and helped choose where to measure, but I didn't use them before the merit budget ran out.
